title: DriveDiT route (capture contract dc-2.0, nav_v1)
description: One route schema for nav_v1, the T0 loop (DD-7-min), the route sampler (DD-7) and C17 (DD-5-min). Coordinates are Enfusion world metres: x east, y up, z north. The polyline is the driving line (already offset to the lane); along-route distances s_m are horizontal (x, z) arc length from the first point. drivedit_nav.validate_route also checks what this schema cannot: segment lengths >= 0.01 m, s_m within the route length, the closed-route tolerance (1 m) and a declared length_m (0.05 m).

route_id.description: Stable id, e.g. arland_t0_loop_v1; recorded per episode.

map_id.description: Canonical map id (never a terrain name such as Cain or Eden).

split.description: Split tag; must belong to map_id (see allOf). Sessions take their split from it; VAL-C is chosen per session, not per route.

lane_side.description: How the driving line was derived: right lane centre, road centreline (narrow roads), or both along the route.

closed.description: True when the first and last point coincide (a loop). nav_v1 never wraps; a multi-lap episode repeats the loop in the polyline.

maneuvers.description: Junction maneuvers in increasing s_m (distinct positions). nav_v1 reports the next one within 200 m, else man_follow.

stops.description: Commanded stops in non-decreasing s_m. A stop at the route end is the same command (kind route_end). nav_v1 gives d_stop = 200 when none is within 200 m.

length_m.description: Optional; if present it must equal the horizontal polyline length within 0.05 m.

source.description: Provenance: generator, graph sha256, seed, input files.
